root_idea.summary: The root centers on something becoming apparent, exposed, or manifest.
root_idea.development: From the notion of appearing in an open, uncovered space developed the designation of the desert and its inhabitants; the same semantic field also includes an opinion arising or changing in the mind.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Plural active-participle form of بَادٍ; represented under its singular citation form.

senses.definition: To appear, become apparent, or come into view; to become manifest or evident.
senses.usage_conditions: An intransitive use describing something previously hidden or unapparent becoming perceptible or clear.

senses.definition: For an opinion or decision to arise in someone’s mind, especially as a view different from an earlier one.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the construction بَدَا لَهُ فِي الأَمْرِ, literally that something appeared to him concerning the matter; the Quranic usage concerns a decision arising after the relevant signs had been seen.

senses.definition: To make something apparent, show it, exhibit it, manifest it, or disclose it.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive causative use with a thing, matter, thought, or feature as its object; the Quran also uses it for making something ordinarily concealed visible.

senses.definition: A person of the open country: a desert-dweller or one coming from the desert, outside settled habitation.
senses.usage_conditions: The singular بَادٍ and the Quranic plural بَادُونَ designate people associated with the bādiyah, in contrast with settled towns or permanent settlements.

senses.definition: At the first or outward appearance of an opinion; hence, according to an initial, superficial, or possibly inconsiderate judgment.
senses.usage_conditions: A conventional construction, بَادِيَ الرَّأْيِ, describing the first impression or apparent judgment rather than a considered conclusion.

senses.definition: The desert or open-country way of life, and the region outside settled habitation.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in opposition to settled urban or village life; in the Quranic construction مِنَ الْبَدْوِ, it denotes the desert country or its way of life.

senses.definition: One who makes something apparent or discloses it.
senses.usage_conditions: The active participle of أَبْدَى; in the Quranic occurrence it is used with a concealed matter as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To begin with someone by doing something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical alternative to بَدَأَنِي.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go out from settled land to the desert or its pasturing places, or to dwell in the desert.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes departure from permanent sources of water or cultivated and settled areas toward open-country pasture, and can also mean remaining there.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To void excrement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage explained as going out from tents or houses into the open country.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To desire or intend to do something, in a figurative usage of the construction in which a course of action presents itself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical interpretation of بَدَا لَهُ أَنْ يَفْعَلَ; it is distinct from the literal arising of an opinion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The land to produce or contain truffles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of land in which بَدَاةٌ, truffles, are found.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The land to contain dust or earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical use of the verb with dust or earth as what the land contains.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make known a want or need that has arisen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is a need or want that has presented itself to the person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To send a horse or other beast out to a place of pasture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported usage concerns sending an animal to pasture, apparently in the desert.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Going out into the field to encounter another in battle or war.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A military use of the verbal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Showing open enmity or hostility toward another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction مُبَادَاةٌ بِالعَدَاوَةِ means openly displaying hostility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Showing or revealing an affair to people or to another person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive construction meaning to make an affair open or known.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Measuring or comparing two things with each other.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction بَادَى بَيْنَهُمَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To show open enmity or hostility toward someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of making one’s hostile attitude openly visible.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of clear water, to show its bottom.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the bottom becoming visible because the water is clear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To deviate from the right way in one’s speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic use referring to faulty or wayward expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To eat the morning meal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal usage reported for the common speech of Yemen; it is synonymous with تَغَدَّى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To affect the manner of, or imitate, the people of the desert.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal-form usage concerning adopting Bedouin behavior or appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Excrement from the anus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun denoting the bodily waste itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A human joint.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is أَبْدَاءٌ; this is a distinct anatomical noun from the excrement sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The first part or beginning of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions meaning first of all or at the outset; the form is related in spelling to the root’s appearance vocabulary but has its own lexical value.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Truffles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun synonymous with كَمْأَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dust or earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct noun sense from بَدَاةٌ meaning truffles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Either side of a valley.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical noun for one of the valley’s two sides.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of, belonging to, or relating to the desert; as a substantive, a Bedouin or desert Arab.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The relational adjective is opposed to the townsman or villager.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An opinion that arises in the mind, especially one different from a former opinion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun derived from بَدَا لَهُ فِي الأَمْرِ; it may describe someone subject to successive opinions, whether approvingly or disparagingly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The morning meal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal usage of Yemen, synonymous with غَدَاءٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A well, especially one that is not ancient.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical adjective or noun used of a newly established or non-ancient well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A want or need that appears or becomes apparent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural denotes wants or needs that emerge and become noticeable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The first thing that appears or becomes apparent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the initial manifestation of something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calamity or misfortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression formed from two nouns.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The desert or open country; land without towns, villages, or cultivated soil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also denotes the places to which people migrate from permanent water sources while seeking pasture; it is opposed to settled country.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A well whose water is showing and uncovered by dust or earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression describes a well with visible water, opposed to one whose water is covered or hidden.

cautions: The Lane citation for بَادِيَ الرَّأْيِ uses historical Quran citation notation and has not been converted into a modern verse location; the example shown uses the independently supplied QAC occurrence at 11:27:19.
The contextual gloss attached to the Mufradat heading باد discusses بَادَ يَبِيدُ, a different lexical root despite the matching spelling, and is not used as evidence for this root.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: Mufradat row 88 concerns بَادَ يَبِيدُ, 'to perish or disperse in the desert,' rather than the ب د و root; it is therefore left unassigned.
